neighbours.label: ' of' after a fraction in a word problem or quantity statement (1/3 of the apples)
fire: Mia picked 20 pears. She gave 1/4 of the pears to Sam and 1/4 of the rest to Lee.
Tom had 30 marbles. He lost 2/5 of the marbles on the way home.
A farmer sold 3/4 of his eggs and kept 1/4 of them for breakfast.
Anna read 1/2 of the book on Monday and 1/3 of it on Tuesday.
The class ate 5/8 of the pizza and saved 3/8 of it for later.
Ben spent 1/3 of his money on lunch and 1/6 of it on a hat.
Of the 60 chairs, 2/3 of them were red and 1/3 of them blue.
Jill baked 24 cookies and gave away 3/4 of the batch.
quiet: Mia picked 20 pears. She gave a few pears to Sam and the rest to Lee.
Tom had 30 marbles. He lost some marbles on the way home.
A farmer sold most of his eggs and kept a dozen for breakfast.
Anna read half the book on Monday and more on Tuesday.
The class ate most of the pizza and saved a slice for later.
Ben spent all his money on lunch and on a new hat.
Of the 60 chairs, many were red and the others blue.
Jill baked 24 cookies and gave away many of the batch.

notes: Murky pole: card has ' of' x7, ' in' x3, ' even' x2, ' last' x2, '_samples', ' least'. Probes: '1/3 of' 0.300, ' least' 0.236, ' even' 0.149; 'first of these' 0.007, 'left of' under 0.01. A guess at one sub-cluster.
